Contents resolved through flat() then the first integer was read from the stream object, which is /Length's reference - every page came out empty (40 chars total)
tokenizer required a show operator immediately after each string, but strings appear as array operands in TJ
string pattern applied to bytes in the image count
limits: LibreOffice output can differ from Word in pagination and fonts; this check establishes that the document opens, lays out 41 pages, places all 10 images and loses no text, not that Word paginates identically. Pixel-level layout was not inspected because the model cannot read images.
